entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Nankumina shi, Obe Yaya Efile Mukulu ngi bampangile bua kukuiuka na kukuuma. Kano kapindji nambuela bobofule buande na bukome buobe, bulanda buande na bulolo buobe . Takui mungi Efile bu Obe ni nya, anka Obe apasana ku masaku, Obe namene shi mukitshibue na mungi.
